title: Encrypt to a content store
description: Encrypts the text with AES_KEY from the store you pick (AES-256-GCM) and saves it as a file in a content store.

fields.name: filename
fields.label: File name
fields.help: Path inside the store; an existing file with that name is replaced.

fields.name: keystore
fields.label: Key store
fields.help: The store holding AES_KEY (it joins the task's stores); the run fails if it has none.
